newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 300 MW peak, firm power for Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 300 MW peak, firm power for Monday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 300 megawatts of peak firm power for Monday pre-schedulings, compared with no peak firm power sales for today, the agency said Friday.
BPA offered the Monday deliveries at $17.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales and $19.00 for California-Oregon border (COB).
BPA also continued to offer non-firm power during off-peak hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT on Monday at $8.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for all deliveries.

Non-firm power at hours ending 0600 and 2300 on Monday was offered at $10.00, while prices for hours ending 0700-0800 were also unchanged at $13.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and $14.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deals.
BPA also offered peak firm power for Saturday and Sunday deliveries at prices between $12.00 and 16.00 per MWh.
Non-firm peak power was offered at $13.00 to $17.00 over the weekend.
